Transformers v5.8.0 and v5.9.0 form a May integration series adding DeepSeek V4 and multiple model-family implementations; this is useful ecosystem evidence but not a standalone frontier-model announcement.
TensorRT-LLM rc15 and rc16 form a May pre-release serving series adding multimodal/model support, DeepSeek V4 kernels, KV-cache changes, disaggregated serving, and VisualGen work.

SGLang's May releases v0.5.11 and v0.5.12 form a coherent serving series covering speculative decoding, disaggregated prefix caching, broad model support, and a substantial DeepSeek V4 inference path.

vLLM's May releases v0.20.1, v0.21.0, and v0.22.0 form a coherent serving series centered on DeepSeek V4 hardening, KV/offload evolution, attention backends, Model Runner V2, and speculative/disaggregated serving.
